message:
The yen receipt now shows `¥500`, and the yen receipt test passes along with the pounds one.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit.

**Fix:** I added a zero-decimal currency set (just `JPY`). `formatMoney` now prints those amounts as they are, with no division and no decimals. Other currencies are unchanged.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and the cart total also format yen correctly now. Nothing else in the repo referenced `JPY`, so no other code or tests depended on the old output.

**Test runner:** `node --test` (and `node --test <file>`) hung here and timed out, with and without `timeout`. I ran the receipt test file directly with `node test/payments-receipt.test.js` instead, and both tests passed. I didn't get a full-suite result, and I didn't find out why the runner hangs.
